entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
1. Heard Sri Satendra Kumar Upadhyay, learned counsel for applicants and learned AGA for opposite party no. 1.
2.

Even in the revised call, none appeared on behalf of opposite party no. 2.
3.

Present application has been preferred to stay/quash the entire proceedings against the applicants arising out of Criminal Case no. 323 of 2015, titled as State Vs. Chetan and others,
relating to case crime no. 487 of 2013, under Section 498-A, 323, 504, 506 of IPC and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Saurikh, District Kannauj, pending in the court of learned Judicial Chetan And 6 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/141437001/
1 Magistrate/Additional Civil Judge (Junior Division) Chhibra Mau, District Kannauj as well as to quash the impugned charge sheet no. 172 of 2014 dated 2.8.2014 submitted by the Investigating Officer in Case Crime No. 487 of 2013 (contained as Annexure no. 4) to this affidavit.
4. Although the submissions which has been extended through the counter affidavit is available in the record and the same has been rebutted in shape of filing rejoinder affidavit, meaning thereby the pleadings are already exchanged and the matter is ripe up for final hearing.
5.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Due to non-presence of learned counsel for opposite party no. 2, there is no option left but to proceed in the matter for deciding the same on the basis of the pleadings extended by learned counsel for the parties and every submission made by learned counsel for the applicant and learned AGA.

6. It is the case of the applicant that immediately after preferring application under Section 9 of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 before the family court, the entire proceedings in shape of Criminal Case no. 323 of 2015 (State vs. Chetan and others) Case Crime no. 487 of 2013 under Section 498A, 323,
504, 506 of IPC and 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Saurikh, District Kannauj has been initiated at the behest of opposite party no. 2 and as such that was far against the reality and the same has been instituted only for harassing the entire family of the applicant.

entities.text: Criminal Case no. 323 of 2015 (State vs. Chetan and others) Case Crime no. 487 of 2013
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
7. Learned counsel for the appellant further submitted that the marriage between applicant no. 1 and opposite party no. 2 was solemnized in the year 2011 and after the gap of near about 4 years, the proceedings which has been put under challenge through the instant petition has been instituted by the opposite party no. 2.
8.
Learned counsel for the applicant has also submitted that the entire prosecution story stated against all the applicants are having no intent of reality in it.
So far as applicant nos. 4 to 7 are concerned they all are residing separately and not much concerned with the opposite party no. 2.
The application under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, has been preferred by the applicant on 27.09.2013 and immediately thereafter first information report has been lodged on 13.12.2013.

During pendency of the instant petition, application preferred under Section 9 of the Act of 1955 has already been decided in favour of the applicant as an ex parte, meaning thereby even after having knowledge and notice of preferring the application under Section 9 of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, by the applicant, opposite party no. 2 deliberately did not put her appearance in the same.

The order passed by learned Family Judge is dated 25.07.2017 and thereafter applicant is having his own independent separate life without having any concern with the opposite party no. 2 Implication of other family members along with the applicant has been protected vide order dated 4.8.2015 at the admission stage passed by co-ordinate Bench of this Court in the instant petition.
9.
Considering all the above mentioned facts and circumstances, along with submission whatsoever is available with the applicant, the same shall be recorded by learned trial court.

In pursuance of the aforementioned facts and circumstances, learned Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate/concerned court is hereby directed to expedite the trial as expeditiously as possible preferably within a period of six months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.

At the time of disposal of the Chetan And 6 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/141437001/
2 trial, judgment passed by Hon'ble Apex Court in case of Kashkashan Kausar alias Sonam and Ors.
vs. State of Bihar and Ors.; AIR 2022 SUPREME COURT 820 in Criminal Appeal no. 195 of 2022 (Arising out of S.L.P. (Crl.) No. 6545 of 2020) which has been apprised by learned counsel for the applicant shall also be taken into consideration.
